Richemont Succession Plan: Founder's Son Appointed Co-Deputy Chairman

Johann Rupert, founder and chairman of luxury goods group Richemont, has appointed his son, Anton Rupert, as co-deputy chairman. This move is part of the company's succession planning. Richemont owns brands including Cartier, Van Cleef & Arpels, and Montblanc. The appointment positions Anton Rupert to potentially take over leadership of the Swiss-based company, which is a major player in the global luxury market.
